components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:42px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:9px 16px; color:#fff; background:var(--green, #24664a); border:0; border-radius:999px; font:700 13px/1.6 ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 180ms ease-out,transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:var(--green-hover, #1d553d); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus, #2f7556) 35%,transparent); outline-offset:3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Text Field

components.css: .ds-field-label { display:grid; gap:7px; color:#d9ddd7; font:650 13px/1.6 ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif; } .ds-field { min-height:44px; padding:9px 11px; color:var(--ink, #1e211e); caret-color:var(--green, #24664a); background:#fbfcfa; border:1px solid #747b72; border-radius:10px; font:400 15px/1.6 ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { border-color:#a3aaa1; } .ds-field:focus { border-color:#91bca5; outline:3px solid rgb(101 173 136 / 24%); }

components.name: Project Row
components.description: A provenance-minded project link with an authored directional SVG affordance.
components.html: 本地优先产品关注用户真正拥有数据和运行权的本地优先软件实践。
components.css: .ds-project-row { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:28px; padding:22px 4px; color:var(--ink, #1e211e); text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #ddded7); font:400 15px/1.6 ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif; transition:color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-project-copy { display:grid; gap:5px; min-width:0; } .ds-project-copy strong { font-size:16px; } .ds-project-copy>span { color:var(--muted, #656961); } .ds-row-arrow { width:20px; height:20px; overflow:visible; fill:none; stroke:var(--green, #24664a); stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; stroke-width:1.5; transition:transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-project-row:hover { color:var(--green-ink, #184b35); } .ds-project-row:hover .ds-row-arrow { transform:translateX(3px); } .ds-project-row:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus, #2f7556) 35%,transparent); outline-offset:3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-project-row,.ds-row-arrow { transition:none; } }

components.name: Success Confirmation
components.description: A reserved live-region line whose authored underline appears only after successful persistence.

components.css: .ds-confirmation { position:relative; min-height:24px; margin:0; color:#b7d8c5; font:400 12px/1.6 ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif; } .ds-confirmation::after { position:absolute; bottom:-2px; left:0; width:36px; height:1px; background:#7fbea0; content:""; transform-origin:left; animation:ds-confirmation-line 420ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } @keyframes ds-confirmation-line { from { transform:scaleX(0); } to { transform:scaleX(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-confirmation::after { animation:none; } }

components.css: .ds-wordmark { display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:10px; color:var(--ink, #1e211e); text-decoration:none; } .ds-wordmark strong { font-family:var(--font-editorial),"Songti SC","Noto Serif CJK SC",serif; font-size:22px; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:-.03em; } .ds-wordmark span { color:var(--muted, #656961); font:650 11px/1.6 ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; letter-spacing:.09em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus, #2f7556) 35%,transparent); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:8px; }

narrative.overview:
Radar is an Operate-mode workbench with the calm authority of a well-kept research desk. Warm paper surrounds precise white evidence surfaces, while the charcoal creation panel feels like the active instrument on that desk. The interface is restrained and information-led: identity and provenance remain legible, controls feel deliberate, and valid emptiness receives the same compositional care as populated states.

Brand expression is concentrated rather than spread everywhere. The self-hosted ZCOOL XiaoWei face gives the Radar wordmark and page-level headings an editorial voice; the rest of the workbench uses a durable system sans stack for fast scanning and mixed Chinese/Latin content. Deep green is reserved for action, focus, health, and authored directional affordances—not decoration. The incumbent visual evidence remains `prototypes/radar-brief-prototype.html` and `docs/radar-product-handoff.html`; the shipped implementation is the normative source for exact values.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper canvas with flat white, hairline-bordered reading surfaces.
One dark creation workbench that clearly distinguishes making from inspecting.
Editorial display type used sparingly; system sans carries operational content.
Deep green communicates action, focus, health, and forward movement.
Responsive topology puts creation before the project list on narrow screens.
Surface seed `e2d76f24` identifies this implemented visual direction.

rules.name: The Green Means Something Rule
rules.body: Deep green is reserved for action, health, focus, and directional affordances; never use it as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Paper and Instrument Rule
rules.body: Reading and evidence live on white paper-like surfaces; the dark workbench is reserved for creation.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: ZCOOL XiaoWei belongs only to the Radar wordmark and page-level `h1`; every workbench control, section title, datum, and paragraph stays in the system sans.

rules.name: The Creation-Before-List Rule
rules.body: Narrow screens must show the creation workbench before the existing-project list; this ordering is a product topology, not a cosmetic rearrangement.

rules.name: The Border-Built Depth Rule
rules.body: Use one-pixel hairlines and tonal separation for structure; do not add ambient card shadows.

dos: Do preserve the Operate-mode hierarchy: task completion, scanability, and inspectable state come before brand theater.
Do keep ZCOOL XiaoWei self-hosted and confined to the Radar wordmark and page-level headings.
Do use white bordered surfaces for evidence and the charcoal surface for creation.
Do keep deep green semantic and rare: action, focus, health, and forward direction only.
Do preserve the creation-before-list mobile topology and the authored SVG row affordance.
Do keep every transition meaningful and provide the global reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don't add ambient shadows, gradients, glass effects, or decorative green washes.
Don't apply the editorial face to controls, metadata, body copy, or dense workbench content.
Don't convert the project list into a feed or flatten provenance into anonymous metadata.
Don't animate error or idle messages with the success confirmation line.
Don't replace the implemented system based only on the evidence prototypes; use them as preserved lineage and the shipped code as exact ground truth.
